title: Marketing Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities: Team and Branch Management: Lead and manage field sales teams of 1525 members across 1–2 branches. Ensure that admissions targets for Orchids International Schools are met consistently. Monitor team performance, provide training, and ensure adherence to processes. Marketing and Business Development: Plan and execute BTL (Below-the-Line) marketing activities, including events, campaigns, and tie-ups with preschools and tutors. Analyze market opportunities and develop actionable field marketing plans. Establish and maintain relationships with external stakeholders to enhance lead generation and brand visibility. Strategize and execute effective campaigns to meet revenue goals. Operations and Reporting: Coordinate seamlessly with marketing and sales teams to align efforts and goals. Plan, organize, and host promotional events to increase awareness and engagement. Track, analyze, and present marketing performance and campaign results. Generate and share detailed marketing reports with actionable insights for improvement

Key Skills: Marketing,Presales,Sales support,Management,Business development,Office,Field sales,Sales
